svg.title: PostgreSQL
svg.desc: PostgreSQL. A relational database: ACID transactions with MVCC, a write-ahead log for durability and replication, SQL and rich indexes. Step 1, Where it sits: Orders and Catalog use PgBouncer; the WAL feeds a hot standby, Debezium and a backup archive. Step 2, MVCC: row versions: T1 adds a row version (qty 6); T2's older snapshot still reads 7, nobody waits; VACUUM cleans up. Step 3, Commit = WAL on disk: COMMIT returns once the WAL is on disk; the page is written later, and WAL replay rebuilds it. Step 4, Replicas and limits: Async replication: during 200 ms of replay lag, a standby report still reads qty 7 after the commit.

g.text: Orders and Catalog use PgBouncer; the WAL feeds a hot standby, Debezium and a backup archive.
T1 adds a row version (qty 6); T2's older snapshot still reads 7, nobody waits; VACUUM cleans up.
COMMIT returns once the WAL is on disk; the page is written later, and WAL replay rebuilds it.
Async replication: during 200 ms of replay lag, a standby report still reads qty 7 after the commit.
